verdict.rationale: Sprinto has API reference pages (Integration Monitoring push APIs, Framework Health & Vendor Data APIs), so this axis applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable OpenAPI or equivalent machine-readable spec, and probes of the common OpenAPI/Swagger paths all returned 404. Human-readable API pages and llms.txt are adjacent artifacts, not a machine-readable API spec, so they earn no credit.
